meta_description: Five control layers mapped to NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001 and the EU AI Act.

blocks.x: Five layers of control from policy to assurance — mapped to NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act.
Responsible AI at Dataq Software is not a policy page; it is five control layers wired into every delivery, mapped to NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act.

items: Policy layer
AI use policies, use-case classification, prohibited-use boundaries, human-oversight requirements.
Data layer
Zero-exposure training posture, consent scopes, PII handling, data lineage into models.
Model layer
Model cards, evaluation puts to work, red-team suites, fairness testing, versioned registries.
Operations layer
Guardrails as code, drift monitoring, incident response, disclosure and appeal paths.
Assurance layer
Control testing, conformity documentation (EU AI Act), internal audit hooks, evidence exports.

blocks.x: High-risk use cases (credit scoring, employment screening, medical triage) ship with documentation, human-oversight gates and post-market monitoring as built artifacts. Every model carries a card, an evaluation report and a named control owner. Zero-exposure architecture means client data is never training material — enforced by design, evidenced by lineage.

items: EU AI Act
Technical documentation, human-oversight evidence and post-market monitoring plans generated per high-risk system.
Model risk
SR 11-7/TRIM-aligned validation packs produced during build, accepted by model-risk committees.
Internal audit
Read-only access to the evidence plane: control tests, decision replay, guardrail configurations.
